acceptance.criterion: A mismatched supplied commit is rejected before mutable test truth assessment and any runner.
Matching source still requires full approved test truth before any execution.
The existing test rejects a forged checked-out revision without weakening its expected error.

evidence.contains: CI and local evidence reject a supplied revision different from checked-out HEAD

acceptance.criterion: Emitted evidence uses the already validated checked-out revision.

constraints: No change to approved normative sources, verification gates, test-oracle expectation or protected merge requirements.
No local Windows process, queue, Pi dispatcher, provider, worktree, project, credential or asset mutation.
Independent seven-layer exact-head CI and code-owner review required; native Windows and product proof remain separate.
